lane: Q4: activation-error attribution and the MobileNetV3-Large repair (B2)
status: written before any new measurement of this lane

evidence.class: development evidence (the 1k screen was used to select the B2 default and is used here to choose repairs)
evidence.evaluation_list: imagenet_screen_1k: all 1000 images in frozen manifest order, batch 8, through the B2 input cache with build=False
evidence.audit_images: first 128 images of imagenet_screen_1k (as the B2 matrix occupancy audit)
evidence.calibration: frozen v1 FP32 observations of imagenet_calibration_2k (read-only) for every activation scale; first 256 images of imagenet_calibration_2k for bias correction (the frozen B2 rule)
evidence.reserved_data: no ImageNet evaluation image outside the 1k screen and no COCO image is used; no held-out confirmation is run

base.engine: B2 FP32 quantize-dequantize surrogate with wide FP32 accumulation (tools/experiment_b2, sources read-only)
base.recipe: frozen B2 default (fused_relu boundaries, unsigned integer codes on provably non-negative boundaries, activation MSE scale, per-channel weight MSE scale, sequential empirical bias correction)
base.readout: b2-tie-readout-1 (tools/experiment_b2/readout.py); primary metric top-1 expected credit

reproduction_gate: Before any arm of a (model, format) runs, the verify job must reproduce the sealed matrix cell <model>--<format>--default: configuration identity, the readout arrays and the logits sha256 through tools.experiment_b2.runner.build, and the same readout arrays and logits sha256 through this lane's arm engine with the empty arm, with all parameters bit-identical after bias correction. Every arm job checks that its shared state (activation scales, weight scales, quantized weights) has the verified fingerprint.

arm_semantics.wide: the named activation boundaries are not quantized (FP32 tensor passed on); every other boundary, all weights and the bias-correction procedure follow the default; bias correction is refitted for the arm's boundary plan (the frozen procedure, run on the arm). Diagnostic only: mixed precision is never proposed as a recipe.
arm_semantics.only: only the named boundaries are quantized; all other boundaries wide (same rules as wide)
arm_semantics.ref_weights_only: every activation boundary wide (weights quantized, bias correction as the default)
arm_semantics.affine: affine (zero-point) code at the named signed boundaries: x_hat = (Q(x/s + z) - z) * s with z a non-positive codebook level; (s, z) from a float64 SSE search over the calibration samples on the B2 ratio grid anchored at the asymmetric span, z = smallest level >= bottom level - min/s; it replaces the B2 symmetric scale only where its error is strictly smaller. Unsigned and wide boundaries are untouched.
arm_semantics.pc: per-channel activation scales (dimension 1) at the named boundaries (never the network input or linear outputs); per-channel B2 MSE search over the v1 calibration samples regrouped by channel with the v1 sampler; every conv/linear consumer gets the per-channel ratios r_c = s_c / s_node folded into its FP32 weights before per-output-channel weight quantization (the QDQ surrogate uses Qw(W*r)/r against the dequantized input, which is the folded hardware computation up to FP32 rounding); elementwise consumers (Hardswish, add, mul, pooling) take the per-channel scale as is.

hardware_semantics.affine: a zero point z changes every consuming MAC: sum w*(q - z) = sum w*q - z*sum(w), a per-output-channel constant precomputed offline and added to the accumulator, and padded positions must use the code z. Accumulator: closed form of tools/scaled_bridge_v2/certificates.py (signed_bits_absolute = bit_length(max|a| * sum|w|) + 1, max over output channels); with the term in the accumulator the bound is max|q|*sum|w| + |z|*|sum w|; with the operand q - z formed first it is max|q - z|*sum|w| (a wider operand). Reported per consuming MAC and as the network maximum for integer formats, from the arm's integer weight codes.
hardware_semantics.pc: per-channel activation scales need a per-channel requantization multiplier at the producer (already per channel after a conv with per-channel weight scales; new for Hardswish/add/mul producers) and, at every consumer, either an exact fold into a depthwise conv's per-channel weight scale (free), a fold into a dense conv's weights before weight quantization (changes the weight codes; reported as the folded accumulator width), or per-channel handling in an elementwise unit (Hardswish LUT or multiplier per channel).

group_rules: tools/experiment_b2_attrib/groups.py (structural, from the FX graph and the B2 default plan; each scheme is a partition of the quantizing boundaries). The lists above are the int8 plan; the same structural plan holds for every scalar format except that unsigned codes exist only for integers.

metrics.primary: top-1 expected credit (tie-aware) on the 1k screen
secondary: mean per-image KL(FP32 || arm) of the softmax logits, nats (FP32 logits recomputed in the job from the frozen FP32 graph)
per-node SQNR of the arm on the 128 audit images (recipe arms)

derived.additivity: sum of D_G and of R_G over the role partition compared with L
derived.sqnr_predictors: from the per-node SQNR stored in the sealed default matrix cell of the same model and format (128 audit images): NSR(S) = sum over S of 10^(-SQNR/10), min SQNR over S, |S|; Spearman rank correlation of each predictor with D_G (only arms), R_G (wide arms), the KL of only:G and the KL reduction of wide:G, over the role groups per format; with node recovery over the leave-one-out nodes
derived.cross_cell: over the sealed matrix cells (scalar formats, default recipe, three networks): Spearman of median SQNR, min SQNR and network NSR with the top-1 drop to FP32, per network and pooled; cells with non-finite SQNR entries excluded and listed

statistics: paired image bootstrap of the mean difference of per-image credits (tools.analysis.b2_ties.paired / tools.analysis.b2_matrix.interval: 10000 resamples, seed 20260927), pointwise 95 percent intervals, no multiplicity correction (stated with every table); Spearman correlations are descriptive (n = 13 role groups per format).

stages.A0_cpu: stored SQNR only (no new inference): per-node SQNR of the MobileNetV3 default cells at int8, int6, fp6_e2m3, fp8_e4m3fn, grouped by the role partition; the cross_cell analysis over all sealed scalar default matrix cells.
stages.V: verify jobs: mobilenet_v3_large int8, int6, fp6_e2m3, fp8_e4m3fn; mobilenet_v2 int8; resnet18 int8; Part C formats before their arms.

A2.rule: per format of A1: rank the role groups by recovery R_G (top-1 expected; ties by KL reduction); leave-one-out arms wide:node.<n> over every node of the top 2 groups; if their union exceeds 40 nodes for a format, the 40 with the lowest stored SQNR in the default cell; nodes already covered by a group arm of size 1 are skipped

B.combination: per format, the better of r1a/r1b combined with the best of r2a-r2d (top-1 expected on the screen; ties by KL) where the two act on disjoint boundaries; if they overlap, the r2 arm restricted to the boundaries the r1 arm does not change
B.r3: at most 8 further uniform-precision arms chosen from the A1/A2 attribution, written as a protocol addendum before they run

arms: the int8 MobileNetV3 combination where its targets exist

gpu_caps.order: V, A1, A2, B, C; a stage starts only if the measured total job wall-clock so far plus its estimate stays under the total cap

stop_rules: any verify check failing stops all arms of that (model, format)
arm jobs never write into artifacts/experiment_b2/
no recipe change is adopted by this lane; whether a repair enters the recipe is the owner's decision
results are reported as measured, including null results
